entities.summary: Richard Nii Armah Quaye is a Ghanaian entrepreneur and Investor. He is the founder of Bills and Quick Angels Limited. As at April 2025, he stepped down as the CEO and board chairman of Quick Angels Limited and board chairman of Bills Micro Credit. He is currently the President of RNAQ Holdings, the parent company that holds Quick Angels Limited and Bills Micro Credit.
